row.evidence: Magnite publishes no pricing, and its only public identity guide configures Okta OIDC SSO for streamr.ai; it says login credentials are required for the majority of its developer documentation, and no SCIM is documented publicly.
row.notes: New in September 2026. Magnite is a sell-side ad platform (DV+, Magnite Streaming/SpringServe, ClearLine, streamr.ai) sold by contract with no public price list. The public help centre has an Okta guide for streamr.ai (OIDC SSO and Universal Logout via Okta Express Configuration; no provisioning listed). SpringServe users are created in the console with an emailed password link. Most product and developer docs sit behind a customer login, so SCIM cannot be ruled out: unknown. magnite.com returned 403 to curl and render.cjs (read via WebFetch).

scim.notes: No SCIM documentation found on magnite.com, the public part of help.magnite.com (search: scim, saml, provisioning, single sign-on returned nothing) or the public SpringServe docs; most product and developer documentation needs a customer login, so absence cannot be confirmed.

rate_limits.text: SpringServe API: max 240 requests/minute per account; auth tokens expire after two hours.

user_api.notes: The SpringServe (Magnite Streaming ad server) API at https://console.springserve.com/api/v0 is documented publicly for ad objects and reporting; no user-management endpoint appears in the public page list. Users are created in the console. Other Magnite developer docs need a login.

okta.notes: Per Magnite's guide, 'streamr.ai' is in the Okta App Catalog with OIDC SSO and Universal Logout via Express Configuration; provisioning is not listed among supported features. OIN page URL not found (okta.com/integrations/streamr-ai/ 404). Covers the streamr.ai product only.

entra.notes: No Entra gallery tutorial found (magnite, streamr-ai tutorial URLs 404).

fallbacks.notes: Most developer documentation needs a customer login.
